motd: Welcome to AhmadOS. Type help to see every command - or start with about, skills or projects.

commands.ls: list files, ls -a shows hidden ones too
commands.cd: change directory, cd .. goes up one level

help.keys: Tab completes commands and paths, arrow up and down bring back earlier commands, Ctrl+L clears the screen, Ctrl+C abandons the line.

ahmados.name: AhmadOS - this website
ahmados.text: 80 years of computing history in seven eras, each with a puzzle that teaches a real foundation of computing - and this desktop at the end. A static website without a server of its own, in German, English and Persian.
